title: Math rendering example
text:
A quick check that maths renders correctly. Inline math like \(e^{i\pi} + 1 = 0\) works within a sentence.
Display equations work too:
\[
\int_{-\infty}^{\infty} e^{-x^2} \, dx = \sqrt{\pi}
\]
As does numbered equation notation with \begin{equation}:
\[
\nabla \times \mathbf{B} - \frac{1}{c}\frac{\partial \mathbf{E}}{\partial t} = \frac{4\pi}{c}\mathbf{J}
\tag{1}\]
Referenced as Equation 1.
